'''Hela Brandes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who served as the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] in the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] under [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] rule.

==Biography==
Brandes served as the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] sitting on the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. She was a noted harpist who attempted to arrange for [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Artist/Legends|artists]] and [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] to travel off-planet to demonstrate the talents their society prided. Brandes was also in charge of the funding of Naboo's festivals.<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Brandes and a coalition of other illustrious musicians coaxed the renowned [[symponik]] master [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]] out of retirement for a one-off special concert to benefit the war orphans.<ref name="Slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hela Brandes was portrayed by an uncredited actress in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].

The character was referred to as "Helena Brandes" in [[Star Wars Kids (1997)|''Star Wars Kids'']] [[Star Wars Kids (1997) 6|issue 6]].
